Df3NusJTkez.caption:
🍁 Discovering Japanese Culture in Autumn 🇯🇵

The Misses visited the Northern Culture Museum in Niigata, Japan!

Once the residence of the wealthy Ito family, the museum showcases traditional Japanese architecture, beautiful gardens, and the rich history of the family.

Surrounded by the beauty of the gardens and historic architecture, the Misses had a wonderful opportunity to experience Japan’s traditional culture and heritage.

It was a special moment filled with the beauty of autumn in Japan! 🍁✨

ミスたちが訪れたのは、新潟県にある「北方文化博物館」！

かつての豪農・伊藤家の歴史を今に伝える、伝統的な日本建築と美しい庭園が魅力の場所です。

四季折々の表情を見せる庭園や、歴史を感じる趣ある建物を通して、日本の伝統文化や美しさに触れるひとときとなりました。

日本の秋ならではの景色とともに、心に残る特別な時間を過ごしました🍂✨

DfvwAFrMXCk.caption:
🇪🇸 Miss International Spain 2026 – Laura Dowell lauradowell 

Laura Dowell, Miss International Spain 2026, is an AI engineer who believes in the power of technology to create a better future.

Through her work with artificial intelligence, she explores new ways to make education more creative, accessible, and engaging. She has developed an educational app that allows children to create their own interactive stories, encouraging them to learn, imagine, and express themselves in new ways.

Her commitment to making a difference goes beyond technology. Since 2022, she has also been volunteering with Community TechAid, helping bring technology and educational opportunities to those who need them most.

Laura believes that while technology continues to evolve, what truly matters is how we care for and support one another. She hopes to inspire a future where innovation and compassion go hand in hand.

Her message is clear: a better future begins when we use our knowledge and creativity to help others.

This video is part of the “Beauties for SDGs” project, inspired by Miss International’s values of Peace, Intelligence, and Compassion.

Miss International Netherlands 🇳🇱 -
Isabel Cramer@isabel_c_soleil 

Isabel Cramer, Miss International Netherlands 2026, is a literary studies master's graduate and fashion designer who aspires to become an author. She hopes to take her creativity further and write a book that inspires many people.

Through her platform "Climate Creatives," Isabel shows that living sustainably can be a creative challenge rather than a burden. With her passion for sewing, she transforms leftover materials into gowns worth cherishing, giving existing resources new life instead of treating fashion as disposable. She believes climate action begins when we feel connected to what we want to protect, and that creativity is the bridge between caring and doing.

Her message is clear: we are not separate from nature, but a part of it. She wants to help people realize why it matters to build a greener, brighter future for the generations to come.

Vice President Ansah Meets Miss International Africa, Miss Universe Zimbabwe 2025

The beauty queens also highlighted their collaboration with the Government of Zimbabwe and their work with young girls and boys living with disabilities across the African continent.

She described them as icons and good leaders who are serving as positive role models for young people in their respective countries.

The beauty queens also presented Vice President Ansah with a gift of Zimbabwean national fabric, an initiative facilitated by the First Lady of Zimbabwe, Auxillia Mnangagwa.

DckcW6-IvT9.caption:
realdanielacosio 
Es una de las modelos mexicanas con mayor trayectoria y proyección internacional. Originaria de La Paz, Baja California Sur, su historia en el mundo de la belleza comenzó en Nuestra Belleza México 2005, donde representó a su estado, obtuvo el reconocimiento de Nuestra Modelo y se convirtió en primera finalista y suplente del certamen.

A partir de ahí comenzó una destacada carrera internacional que la llevó a trabajar en algunas de las principales capitales de la moda, como Nueva York, Milán y París, y a desfilar para reconocidos diseñadores y casas de moda como Giorgio Armani, Jean Paul Gaultier, Vivienne Westwood, Marchesa, Guess y Georges Hobeika.

A lo largo de su trayectoria, Daniela ha sido imagen y ha participado en campañas internacionales para importantes firmas de moda y belleza como Maybelline New York, L’Oréal, Clarins, Pantene, Ralph Lauren, Victoria’s Secret, Abercrombie & Fitch, Guess y Express, entre muchas otras. Su trabajo también ha aparecido en publicaciones internacionales como Vogue, Elle y Harper’s Bazaar.

Su éxito comercial la llevó además a formar parte del ranking “Money Girls” de Models.com, que reconocía a algunas de las modelos con mayor éxito comercial dentro de la industria internacional, consolidando una carrera de más de dos décadas como uno de los rostros mexicanos con mayor presencia en el mundo de la moda.

DckcRbSo-Dx.caption:
aaronmercury 
Actor, creador y referente de una nueva generación, Aarón Mercury llega a Miss Universe México 2026.

Su autenticidad y capacidad para conectar con millones y marcar tendencias lo han convertido en una de las figuras más relevantes de su generación, con una carrera que hoy trasciende las redes y llega también a la actuación. ✨

Dckb7SXIDOF.caption:
ilda.ledesma 
Es una reconocida y destacada empresaria en el sector turístico, hotelero y de propiedad vacacional en Baja California Sur.
Es socia fundadora del emblemático y exitoso proyecto Corazón Cabo Resort & Spa, y a lo largo de su trayectoria profesional, ha tenido una participación activa en importantes asociaciones empresariales, entre ellos Asudéstico, AMEXME, Club Skal, siempre promoviendo la colaboración, desarrollo y competitividad dentro del sector turístico y empresarial del Estado.

De2EYVTRwkS.caption:
Because beauty is truly born Beyond The Crown ❤️‍🩹

Presenting my advocacy project for Miss Universe 2026. “Dare To Be Yourself” is an initiative that stems from my own personal experience with school bullying, an issue that’s still relevant in our classrooms today. Through this project, I aim to reach schools all around Chile and hopefully the world to talk with students about bullying prevention, give them resources to find help if needed and also remind them of the importance of nourishing their essences no matter what others may say.

I was able to rewrite my story with my own words when others tried to do it for me. It is now my dream to inspire children and young people to do the same.

I am so moved to be given this platform to be an actual agent of change. This is just the beginning. 

Follow our project here atreveteasertu.cl and vote for it through the MU Fan app ✨

A través de este proyecto, busco llegar a colegios de todo Chile y, ojalá, del mundo, para conversar con los estudiantes sobre la prevención del bullying, entregarles herramientas para encontrar ayuda cuando lo necesiten y recordarles la importancia de cultivar su esencia, sin importar lo que los demás puedan decir.

DeNuTkGkcXT.caption:
Recuerdos de mi primera vez en Puerto Rico 🇵🇷 

Qué hermoso día lleno de cultura y goce. Empezamos visitando la Hacienda Muñoz (hacienda_munoz) en San Lorenzo donde aprendí sobre la producción del café de especialidad boricua y también sobre la historia de las fincas en el país. 

Luego nos deleitamos con comida puertorriqueña tradicional en Zafra (zafradelcaribe_ ) donde cada plato hacía bailar al paladar. 

Después visitamos en faro Punta Tuna en Maunabo, un lugar que durante siglos fue la estrella guía de los barcos que llegaban a la isla.

Y finalizamos el día en Río Grande, donde las vistas del imponente Yunque, el único bosque tropical lluvioso en el sistema forestal nacional de Estados Unidos, fueron la imagen perfecta para finalizar el día. 

Gracias cristiandianapr y tiagocristinaa por acompañarme y hacer de este viaje algo aún más memorable 💗 Mañana seguiremos #DescubriendoLaIsla

DdT76ygDgfF.caption:
Meet Miss Universe Canada 2026, Aslihan Morali. 🇨🇦

Aslihan’s journey is one shaped by resilience, opportunity and purpose. After immigrating to Canada from Türkiye as a young girl and being raised by a single mother, she grew up with a deep appreciation for education, perseverance and the freedom to dream beyond one’s circumstances.

Today, she carries that story with her as she prepares to represent Canada on the Miss Universe stage in Puerto Rico.

For Aslihan, the crown represents far more than a title. It is a platform to connect with communities, advocate for education and opportunity, and remind others that where you begin does not determine where you are going.

We are proud to stand behind a Canadian representative who leads with authenticity, kindness and purpose, and we look forward to sharing this journey with all of you as she takes Canada to the Miss Universe stage. 🇨🇦✨

The road to Miss Universe begins now.

DdSA6EfTaj-.caption:
Reliving the crowning of our 2026 Miss Universe Canada, Aslihan Morali! We have no doubt that she will represent Canada proudly at the 75th Miss Universe Canada pageant in November in Puerto Rico ! 

As a child, Aslihan Morali walked across the Buffalo-Niagara bridge into Canada as a refugee with two suitcases and a dream. Today she is a model, humanitarian, and founder of Leap Global Voices, delivering educational resources to children in the Philippines, sponsoring girls’ education in Türkiye, and leading empowerment workshops across Canada. A longtime supporter of the SickKids Hospital Burn & Plastics Gala, trained by world-renowned supermodel Coco Rocha, and guided by faith and purpose, Aslihan proves every day that where you begin never determines where you are going.

MELINA SVAB - REGIONAL DIRECTOR OF WESTERN ONTARIO 

Miss Universe Canada is proud to welcome Melina Svab as the official regional Director of Western Ontario! 

Melina Svab brings more than a decade of experience in the pageant world, pairing deep industry expertise with a strategic, people-first approach to mentorship. With a proven track record across a diverse range of competitions, including Miss Windsor, Miss LaSalle, Miss Tecumseh, and Miss Universe Canada, Melina has developed a well-rounded perspective on what it takes to cultivate confident, high-performing titleholders and standout delegates. As a former Miss Tecumseh titleholder, she brings authentic, firsthand insight into the demands of the stage and the responsibility of representing a community with excellence, integrity, and purpose.

Melina is a graduate of the University of Windsor, where she earned a degree in Visual Arts and Psychology, an interdisciplinary foundation that uniquely positions her to support delegates through both a creative and human-centered lens. Her approach blends presentation, branding, and stage presence with a strong understanding of mindset, confidence-building, and personal growth helping delegates refine not just how they show up, but how they evolve throughout the process.

Df2Gulht7gY.caption:
FROM 1952 TO 2026 – 75 YEARS OF MISS UNIVERSE ✨👑🇩🇰

From the very first Miss Universe competition in 1952, when Hanne Sørensen proudly represented Denmark, to Fie Rose, representing our country at the historic 75th edition of Miss Universe in Puerto Rico.

Two women. Two generations. One dream. 🇩🇰

For 75 editions, Miss Universe has celebrated beauty, confidence, ambition, and the power of women from around the world.

Today, we honor Denmark’s journey through the decades, from where it all began to the incredible women who continue to carry our flag onto the international stage.

Different eras, the same Danish pride.

As Fie Rose takes part in this milestone edition, we celebrate the past, embrace the present, and look forward to the future of Miss Universe Denmark.

A legacy that began in 1952. A story that continues today✨

#MissUniverseDenmark #MissUniverse2026 #75thMissUniverse #FieRose #MissUniverse #Denmark

De2W3lXsHn2.caption:
Every child deserves to know: I matter. I belong. My future holds possibilities.

For Miss Universe Estonia, Emili Denneng, this is personal. Having experienced bullying herself, she knows how much it matters to feel accepted and believed in.

Kambuka is a youth club in Estonia that organizes camps and activities where children can find friends, discover their strengths, and feel free to be themselves. A place where “Can I join?” becomes “We’re so glad you’re here.”

But some families cannot afford that opportunity. Emili wants to help change this.
Your support can help cover a child’s participation. Your time and skills can help them feel heard and encouraged.

We cannot erase what a child has been through. But together, we can help them believe that their future can be different. 🤍

Df7TnBcEQ7E.caption:
Closed-Door Interview Look 🇯🇵✨

Sayuki is in her closed-door interview right now, proudly representing Japan. Sending her all our love and support🤍

Designed for the Miss Universe interview, this look expresses quiet confidence and intellect, inner strength, and the determination to take flight on the world stage.

A sharp white vest paired with black trousers creates a poised silhouette.

The long cape flowing from the shoulders features cranes reminiscent of Japanese ink paintings and a golden circle. Elegant and composed at rest, the design brings the cranes to life in movement, as though they are spreading their wings.

Inspired by the Japanese appreciation for space and the fluidity of brushstrokes, this creation embodies a woman who is thoughtful and composed, strong at her core, and ready to spread her wings to the world.

たった今、さゆきが日本代表としてクローズドドア・インタビューに挑んでいます🇯🇵
皆さま、応援よろしくお願いいたします🤍

世界大会のインタビュー衣装として、静けさと知性を感じさせながら、その内側にある強さと、世界へ羽ばたいていく意志を表現しました。

白を基調としたシャープなジレスタイルに黒のパンツを合わせ、凛とした佇まいに。

肩から長く流れるケープには、墨絵を思わせる鶴と金の円を配置し、静止している時には端正に、動いた時には鶴が大きく羽ばたくように見えるデザインにしています。

日本らしい余白や筆の流れを大切にしながら、
「静かで知性的でありながら、芯には強さを持ち、世界へ羽ばたいていく」
そんな姿を一着の中に形にしました。

日本初の女性総理大臣である高市総理を表敬訪問させていただくという、大変貴重な機会となりました。

懇談では、世界大会への出場を前に温かい激励のお言葉をいただくとともに、日本の魅力を世界へ発信していくことについて、そして「女性として」という枠にとらわれず、一人の人間、一人のリーダーとしてどうあるべきか、高市総理が考えるリーダー像についてもお話を伺うことができ、多くの学びと気づきをいただきました。

Magdaline Cherestal’s childhood was not easy. Growing up in Haiti, she experienced difficult moments that shaped her strength, resilience, and compassion for others. At just five years old, she witnessed the devastating impact of the January 12, 2010 earthquake, a magnitude 7.0 disaster that claimed more than 220,000 lives according to Haiti’s official estimates and forced over a million people to leave their homes.

As she grew older, life continued to present challenges, but these experiences taught her the importance of perseverance, faith, and hope. Her childhood helped her understand that even in the darkest moments, people can find the courage to rebuild and support one another. Today, these lessons inspire her to serve her community, empower young people, and use her voice to create positive change. Her story is a reminder that difficult beginnings do not define a person’s future; they can become the foundation of a life dedicated to making a difference.

It deeply saddens me to witness them consumed by flames and toxic crude, yet we cannot turn away.

Miss Earth is not always about glamour; it’s about advocacy. In line with our theme, “Love in Action", Miss Earth transcends beauty and pageantry by inspiring meaningful action through environmental protection, sustainable education, community outreach, and climate change advocacy.

It means standing in the gap when our land is bleeding and using our platform to fight for real change.

This tragedy is happening now, in real time, and our environment needs us to turn empathy into impact. Join us in standing together for immediate restoration and long-term protection of our precious wetlands. 

Our ecosystems deserve our care, and our people deserve a safe, sustainable home.

De8YE09ksm3.caption:
Earth Day in Action for a Cleaner Coast

A few days before Earth Day, we chose to do something rather than simply talk about it.

At Foz do Arelho, I joined a large community beach and lagoon clean-up that brought together around 100 people. Together, we removed approximately 548 kg of waste from the area, waste that could otherwise have remained in or reached the lagoon and the ocean.

Beyond the numbers, this activity helped me understand what happens to the waste we leave behind. Plastic does not simply disappear. It can fragment into smaller particles, enter aquatic ecosystems, affect marine life and eventually become part of the food chain.

That made me look differently at something as simple as a piece of plastic left on the sand. What we leave behind has a journey, and its impact can continue long after we walk away.

Foz do Arelho is part of the place I call home. Caring for it means more than keeping a beach clean, it means protecting the lagoon, the ocean, the biodiversity they support and, ultimately, ourselves.

As Miss Earth Portugal 2026, I want to be part of environmental action that I can experience and understand firsthand. And this day showed me the true power of collective action, around 100 people, approximately 548 kg of waste removed, and one ecosystem left cleaner than we found it.

Earth Day may come once a year. Our responsibility does not.

Bárbara Costa | Miss Earth Portugal 2026

Dex3IZ3CNyH.caption:
The Water Cycle in Action

On World Water Day, I visited the Salinas de Rio Maior to explore a remarkable example of how the water cycle connects nature, geology and our everyday lives.

Here, rainwater infiltrates the ground and travels through layers of rock, reaching underground deposits of rock salt that naturally make the water saline. At the surface, sun, wind and evaporation gradually leave behind salt crystals, while the water returns to its natural cycle, a process that has supported salt production here for centuries.

Something as familiar as the salt on our table is therefore the result of an extraordinary natural journey, connecting water, geology, natural resources and human tradition.

As Miss Earth Portugal 2026, I believe protecting water also begins with understanding the processes it makes possible and recognizing how deeply our lives depend on them.

From rain, through the Earth, to salt, every drop is part of a much bigger story.

DejRMAODiHp.caption:
Does anyone else love desserts like cake or cookies? Today I want to introduce another way we can care for our Earth. I've always loved desserts—but recently I started discovering vegan desserts, which let me enjoy something I love while also being kinder to the planet. That’s why I want to introduce a well-known vegan dessert café in Korea, Plant Bakery Seoul plantbakeryseoul 🍰

Let me share why vegan desserts and bakeries make such a positive impact on our Earth 

🌾Plant-Based Baking, Lighter on the Earth
Traditional baking relies heavily on dairy, eggs, and butter — ingredients tied to animal agriculture, one of the biggest contributors to greenhouse gas emissions. Vegan bakeries replace these with plant-based alternatives, significantly reducing their environmental footprint.

💧Saving Water, One Bake at a Time
Producing dairy and eggs requires enormous amounts of water. By using plant-based ingredients like oat milk, almond butter, and flax eggs, vegan desserts help conserve one of our Earth‘s most precious resources.

🐄Reducing the Impact of Animal Agriculture
Choosing vegan desserts means choosing not to support industrial animal farming — a major source of deforestation, methane emissions, and land degradation. Every bite becomes a small but meaningful act of care for the Earth.

♻Mindful, Sustainable Ingredients
Many vegan bakeries, like Plant Bakery Seoul, focus on natural, sustainably sourced ingredients — supporting a food culture that's better for both our bodies

DeYijN3DXo2.caption:
Underwater Lagoon – A Cocoon of Biodiversity

As part of my role as Miss Earth Portugal 2026, I had the privilege of attending the opening of the photographic exhibition “Lagoa Subaquática – Um Casulo de Biodiversidade” (“Underwater Lagoon – A Cocoon of Biodiversity”) in Foz do Arelho, an environmental education initiative promoted by the Municipality of Caldas da Rainha.

Through 20 underwater photographs, the exhibition reveals a reality that often remains hidden beneath the waters of Óbidos Lagoon: an ecosystem rich in biodiversity, where seagrass meadows play an essential role in the reproduction, feeding, and development of different species of fish, crustaceans, and molluscs.

As a partner of the Caldas da Rainha Environmental Department, participating in this eco-activity allowed me to gain a closer understanding of the biodiversity of a territory that I also represent, while contributing to raising awareness within the community about the importance of its conservation.

Because protecting nature also begins with knowing it. And bringing to light what exists beneath the surface is a way of bringing people closer to nature and showing them the value of what we have right here, so close to us.

Her Love in Action advocacy inspires people to reconnect with nature through the choices they make every day, reminding us that protecting our planet can begin with something simple: valuing what we already have.

Small choices. Meaningful action. A better Earth.

#MissEarth #MissEarth2026 #LoveInAction

DdyBquwzsoR.caption:
Introducing Miss Cayman Islands 2026, Cass Davis Quintero — an Administrative Assistant & Dance Instructor whose Love in Action advocacy inspires sustainable living by transforming creativity and DIY arts into meaningful environmental action.

Through creativity, resourcefulness, and hands-on artistry, she encourages everyone to create, reuse, and make a positive difference—one action at a time.

#MissEarth #MissEarth2026 #LoveInAction

Ddxm9UZTUHw.caption:
Please welcome Helena Ristevski, Miss Earth Australia 2026, a Law/Journalism student and passionate advocate for a more sustainable future.

Through her Love in Action initiative, the “Too Good to Toss Project,” Helena inspires people to value what they have, repurpose what they can, and reduce unnecessary waste from ending up in landfills. Because nothing is truly too good to toss when it can be given a second life.

#MissEarth #MissEarth2026 #LoveInAction

DdvzCZJTVif.caption:
Please welcome Matangaro Tarabay, Miss Earth Cook Islands 2026 — a National Environment Service Intern and Fashion Sales Assistant whose Love in Action advocacy is dedicated to protecting the land and ocean she proudly calls home.

Through environmental restoration, education, and everyday action, Matangaro inspires her community to care for nature and take meaningful steps toward a more sustainable future.

Her message is simple yet powerful: protect our home today, so it can thrive for generations to come.

#MissEarth #MissEarth2026 #LoveInAction

Ddve5asTWlo.caption:
Presenting Miss Earth Finland 2026, Annika Viertola — a culinary student pursuing a Vocational Qualification in Restaurant and Catering Services, and a passionate advocate for sustainable fashion. 

Her Love in Action advocacy is centered on creating an eco-friendly swimwear brand that inspires people to protect the Baltic Sea and our oceans through conscious and sustainable fashion.

Annika believes that fashion can be a powerful force for change — proving that we can make environmentally responsible choices without compromising beauty, style, or confidence.

By bringing sustainability and fashion together, she hopes to inspire people to embrace small, meaningful actions every day that can create a lasting positive impact on our planet.

#MissEarth #MissEarth2026 #LoveInAction

DdvA8o-TyWB.caption:
Please welcome Brianna Foster, Miss Earth Jamaica 2026 — a Bachelor of Science student specializing in Nursing and a passionate advocate for a cleaner, greener Jamaica. 

Her Love in Action advocacy transforms everyday food and organic waste into life-giving compost, turning kitchen scraps into nutrient-rich soil while giving waste a second purpose. 

#MissEarth #MissEarth2026 #LoveInAction

DdtMuSoT6P3.caption:
Miss Earth Macau 2026, Jolie Feilie, is a Model whose love for the environment began in childhood. 

Through her LOVE IN ACTION advocacy, “Healing the Planet with the Ones We Love,” Jolie believes that protecting our planet can bring people together, inspiring families and communities to take meaningful action for a healthier Earth.

#MissEarth #MissEarth2026 #LoveinAction

Dds8lmbzSwD.caption:
Miss Earth Cuba 2026, Adrianna Carrandi, is a cosmetologist who believes that meaningful change begins with the power of one. 

Her Love in Action is about empowering individuals to turn their everyday actions into a collective movement for a healthier and more sustainable Earth. 

#MissEarth #MissEarth2026 #LoveinAction

Dds4QB0zr5c.caption:
Miss Earth Iceland 2026, Lilja Sif Pétursdóttir, is a Retail Manager who believes that kindness can inspire meaningful change.

Through her LOVE IN ACTION advocacy, “Roots of Kindness,” Lilja believes that by planting kindness in people and communities, we can grow collective action that protects our planet and creates a more compassionate and sustainable future for generations to come.

#MissEarth #MissEarth2026 #LoveinAction

DciI95GzKG_.caption:
To the brave families and people of Nepal,

Our hearts are heavy with sorrow following the devastating calamity that struck your beautiful nation last Wednesday. On behalf of the entire Miss Earth global family, we are reaching out to share our deepest sympathies, unwavering solidarity, and heartfelt prayers during this time of profound grief and uncertainty.

At Miss Earth, we believe that our connection to the planet is inseparable from our connection to one another. When the earth trembles and brings hardship to a community, the pain is felt across the globe. We are mourning with you for the precious lives lost, and we are holding space in our hearts for those who are injured, displaced, and grieving.

Please know that you are not alone. The Miss Earth organization, along with our titleholders, partners, and supporters worldwide, sends our most earnest prayers for the swift recovery of the wounded and comfort for the brokenhearted. We also pray for strength, safety, and guidance for the rescue workers and volunteers who are tirelessly helping in the aftermath. 

The resilience, grace, and enduring spirit of the Nepali people have always been an inspiration to the world. Though the ground may have shaken, the strength of your community remains unshakable. 

We stand with you in prayer, in spirit, and in support, today and in the days of healing and rebuilding ahead. 

With deepest sympathy and endless prayers,

The Miss Earth Family

Foto de Jorge Ferráez, con el sello del 75° aniversario de Miss Universe Puerto Rico.
